title: 第一卷 第4章 清月，烈阳，血脉升华！
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天武境第九重巅峰！

这样的境界，在姜临天等人面前，无异于蝼蚁！

若是在外面遇到这种境界的修士，他们连看都懒得看一眼。

可如今，却一个个神情震撼，瞠目结舌。

“我不是在做梦吧，小无痕居然拥有了天武境的修为？”

“凡体，居然也能修炼！”

“小无痕，这到底怎么回事？”

一时间，众人纷纷围了上来，七嘴八舌询问。

“行了！”

姜临天开口，再次压过了众人。

他看着姜无痕，强压内心的激动，淡然道：“都别急，让无痕慢慢说！”

看着家族长辈们迫切的眼神，姜无痕轻笑道：“家主，各位长老，我现在已经不是凡体，而是圣体——”

“万道欲仙圣体！”

此话一出，众人不由得愣了一下。

他们也算是见多识广，对诸天万界的特殊体质颇为了解。

可这万道欲仙圣体，却是头一回听说？

“《万族体质录》当中，有这种圣体吗？”

“既然是圣体，有何过人之处？”

“这圣体，是何时觉醒，又是如何觉醒的？”

众人的问题像是连珠炮似的，一个接一个的追问。

随即，姜无痕把万道欲仙圣体的作用，以及系统的存在，一五一十的告诉了在场众人。

一时间，全场死寂！

系统的存在，即便对于这群准帝、大圣级别的强者来说，也是有些匪夷所思。

见姜临天等人面面相觑，表情疑惑的模样，姜无痕直接从系统空间内，取出了《大品仙王诀》和乾坤熔炉！

“家主，长老，这《大品仙王诀》乃是一部完整的仙阶功法，刚猛霸道，正适合我族强者修炼。”姜无痕目光灼灼，望着众人，“还有这件极道帝兵，亦是至刚至阳的神兵利刃，与我族契合！”

众人见状，眼里顿时迸发出狂喜之色。

仙阶功法，极道帝兵！

这可都是能够提升家族底蕴的战略级资源！

“无痕，这些……难道都是那所谓的‘系统’给你的？”

姜临天眼神炽热，激动问道。

“是，而且，还有——”姜无痕又取出两枚天圣丹，侃侃而谈，“这是天圣丹，属于造化仙丹。其功效，是能让特殊体质进行升华！”

又是一个重磅消息！

修炼者所拥有的体质是先天决定的，除非拥有大造化，否则不会改变。

倘若姜家早有此物，给姜无痕服用后，让他从凡体晋升为灵体，能够正常修炼，后续拿资源堆，也能给他堆到圣人！

可若是让神体天骄服用，那将直接晋升圣体！

这可是妥妥的大帝苗子，万年难遇！

即便成不了大帝，大成圣体也可叫板大帝，比肩准圣巅峰！

这一刻，就连姜临天都忍不住疯狂了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The peak of the ninth level of Tianwu Realm!

In this state, in front of Jiang Lintian and others, they are no different than ants!

If they meet a monk of this level outside, they won't even bother to take a look.

But now, all of them looked shocked and dumbfounded.

"I'm not dreaming, am I? Little Wuhen actually has the cultivation level of Tianwu Realm?"

"You can actually practice in a mortal body!"

"Xiao Wuhen, what's going on?"

For a moment, everyone gathered around and asked questions.

"Okay!"

Jiang Lintian spoke, overwhelming everyone again.

He looked at Jiang Wuhen, suppressed the excitement in his heart, and said calmly: "Don't be anxious, let Wuhen speak slowly!"

Looking at the eager eyes of the family elders, Jiang Wuhen chuckled and said: "Master, elders, I am no longer a mortal body, but a holy body -"

"The Holy Body of Ten Thousand Paths of Desire!"

As soon as these words came out, everyone couldn't help but be stunned.

They are also well-informed and have a good understanding of the special physiques of the heavens and the world.

But this is the first time I’ve heard of this Ten Thousand Paths of Desire Holy Body?

"Is there such a holy body in the "Physique Record of Ten Thousand Races"?"

"Since it is the Holy Body, what is so special about it?"

"When did this Holy Body awaken, and how did it awaken?"

Everyone's questions were like a barrage, one after another.

Immediately, Jiang Wuhen told everyone present the functions of the Wandao Yuxian Holy Body and the existence of the system.

For a moment, the whole place was dead silent!

The existence of the system is a bit unbelievable even to this group of quasi-emperors and great saint-level experts.

Seeing Jiang Lintian and others looking at each other with confused expressions, Jiang Wuhen directly took out the "Great Immortal King's Art" and the Qiankun Furnace from the system space!

"Master, elder, this "Grand Immortal King Technique" is a complete immortal-level technique. It is fierce and domineering, and is suitable for the cultivation of strong people in our clan." Jiang Wuhen looked at everyone with blazing eyes, "And this Ji Dao Emperor Weapon is also the most powerful and powerful divine weapon and sharp blade, and it is in harmony with our clan!"

When everyone saw this, their eyes suddenly burst into ecstasy.

Immortal-level skills, extremely powerful imperial weapons!

These are strategic resources that can enhance the family’s heritage!

"Wuhen, are these...all given to you by the so-called 'system'?"

Jiang Lintian's eyes were burning and he asked excitedly.

"Yes, and, there is also -" Jiang Wuhen took out two more Heavenly Saint Pills and started talking, "This is the Heavenly Saint Pill, which is a good fortune elixir. Its effect is to sublimate special physiques!"

Another big news!

The physique of a cultivator is determined innately and will not change unless he has great fortune.

If the Jiang family had already had this thing, after giving it to Jiang Wuhen, he would be promoted from a mortal body to a spirit body, and he would be able to practice normally. If he piles up resources in the future, he would also be able to pile up saints!

But if the genius of the divine body takes it, he will be directly promoted to the holy body!

This is a perfect seedling of the Great Emperor, a rare thing to come across in a million years!

Even if he can't become a great emperor, he can still be called a great emperor by becoming a holy body, comparable to the pinnacle of quasi-saints!

At this moment, even Jiang Lintian couldn't help but go crazy.
